senses.gloss: छिन्दक, अस्, m., N. of a family or race.

छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided, torn, broken, de-
stroyed; decaying, declining, exhausted, tired; (आ), f.
a whore, a harlot; the tree Cocculus Cordifolius, =
गुडूची.
—छिन्न-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, having the ears
cut off.
—छिन्न-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair cut,
shorn, shaven.
—छिन्न-ग्रन्थिनिका, f. a kind of
bulbous plant, = त्रि-पर्णिका.
—छिन्न-द्रुम, अस्,
m. a riven tree.
—छिन्न-धन्वन्, आ, m. a warrior
whose bow has been cut or broken by his enemy's
arrow.
—छिन्न-नासिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
nose cut off, noseless.
—छिन्न-नास्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the nose-rein (or cord passing through the
nose) cut or broken.
—छिन्न-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the wings clipped or torn off.
—छिन्न-पत्-
त्री, f., N. of a plant, = अम्बष्ठा.
—छिन्न-बन्-
धन, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed from bonds, liberated.
—छिन्न-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced through and
through, cut up, destroyed, scattered.
—छिन्न-भू-
यिष्ठधूम, अस्, आ, अम्, bursting through the thick
smoke, scattering the mass of smoke.
—छिन्न-
मस्त or छिन्न-मस्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, decapitated;
(आ), f. a headless form of Durgā.
—छिन्न-
मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up by the root.
—छिन्न-
रुह, अस्, m., N. of a tree, = तिलक; (आ), f.
N. of several plants, viz. Cocculus Cordifolius;
incense, = शल्लकी; also = स्वर्ण-केतकी.
—छिन्-
न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having cut or cut off.
—छिन्न-
वेशिका, f. the plant Clypea Hernandifolia, = पाठा.
—छिन्न-श्वास, अस्, m. interrupted or irregular
breathing, a kind of asthma; (अस्, आ, अम्), breathing
at irregular intervals.
—छिन्न-संशय, अस्, आ, अम्,
one whose doubts are dispelled, freed from doubt;
confirmed, confident.
—छिन्नोद्भवा (˚न-उद्˚), f.
the plant Cocculus Cordifolius, = गुडूची.

छिन्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a little cut off, in-
cised; (Compar. छिन्नक-तर = छिन्नतरक.)
